messages.subject: Northwind — post-completion covenant monitoring
messages.plaintextBody:
Lesley,

A quick note for the finance team ahead of completion. The debt & covenant model shows base-case leverage at 3.63x at completion, inside the 3.50x→3.00x step-down trajectory by the December test, with the first formal test at 30 September (leverage and DSCR). Minimum liquidity (£1.5m) is tested monthly. I'd suggest we diarise the compliance certificate and keep Marlow's 13-week cashflow running through Q3 — Sterling will be watching it closely.

Happy to set up a 15-minute handover with your team.

James
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
